axis.description: Axis along which to compute standard deviation. Default is to compute the standard deviation of the flattened tensor.
constraints: If not provided, the standard deviation of the flattened tensor is computed.

keepdims.description: If this is set to `True`, the axes which are reduced are left in the result as dimensions with size one.
constraints: x and keepdims must be compatible.

output.description: Output tensor containing the standard deviation values.

constraints: x and keepdims must be compatible.
